acf.procut:
A solid connection is built upon a great seal. Our VX & AX gaskets deliver a perfect seal consistently.” – Asian Sealing Products.

Welcome to Asian Sealing Products, your trusted partner for high-quality gasket solutions. The importance of reliable sealing must be addressed in industrial and engineering applications. Whether you are in the oil and gas industry, chemical processing, or any other sector requiring a dependable seal, our VX and AX gaskets are engineered to meet and exceed your expectations.

acf.gaskets_materials_descriptions: The use of state-of-the-art materials in our VX gaskets ensures that they deliver lasting performance and durability. These gaskets are provided in diverse materials, including graphite, PTFE, and various metal alloys… This wide array ensures you will discover the ideal gasket for your particular requirements, particularly in flange connections where a dependable seal is paramount.

gaskets_materials_types.gaskets_materials_types_content: The AX gasket series is synonymous with reliability. It is designed to provide a consistent and dependable seal in various environments. When you need a gasket you can trust to do its job without fail, AX is your choice.

gaskets_materials_types.gaskets_materials_types_title: Wide Range of Sizes and Materials
gaskets_materials_types.gaskets_materials_types_content: AX gaskets come in various sizes and materials to cater to multiple applications. You can count on AX to deliver the seal you need, from soft to metallic gaskets.

AX gaskets have extensive use in HVAC, plumbing, and automotive sectors. Their versatility and reliability make them a preferred choice for sealing in numerous applications, including flange connections.

products_details.products_details_descriptions:
• Unmatched Performance: The VX gasket series is designed for applications where outstanding performance is non-negotiable. These gaskets are known for their exceptional ability to withstand high pressure, extreme temperatures, and aggressive chemicals. When your operations demand a gasket that never compromises on performance, our VX series rises to the occasion.
  • Versatility: VX gaskets have applications in various industries, including petrochemicals, pharmaceuticals, and power generation. They are versatile enough to handle diverse sealing requirements, making them the go-to choice for professionals who demand excellence in ring joint gaskets and other sealing applications.

• Superior resistance to extreme temperatures and pressure
  • Excellent chemical resistance
  • Long-lasting performance and durability
  • Suitable for various industrial applications, including flange connections and ring joint gaskets
  • Reliable sealing for diverse applications
  • Available in various sizes and materials
  • Dependable performance in different industries

At Asian Sealing Products, we take pride in our commitment to quality and customer satisfaction. The following advantages back our VX and AX gaskets:
  • Extensive Expertise: With years of experience in the sealing solutions industry, we have the expertise to guide you to the best gasket for your unique needs, whether for flange connections, ring joint gaskets, or other critical applications.
  • Uncompromised Quality: Recognizing the pivotal role gaskets play in your operations, we ensure the production of all our gaskets to the highest standards, ensuring a top-tier product every time.
  • Competitive Pricing: We believe that high quality can be achieved without an extravagant price tag. Our VX and AX gaskets are competitively priced, offering you the best value for your investment.
  • Customer Support: Our dedication doesn’t cease after the sale. We offer exceptional customer assistance to attend to your inquiries and any apprehensions you might possess.

acf.faq_title: Answers to all your possible questions.

faq_content.faq_question: What is the difference between VX and AX gaskets?
faq_content.faq_answer: VX gaskets are designed for face-to-face sealing between hubs, while AX gaskets are used for flange-to-flange sealing.

faq_content.faq_question: Do you provide technical support for selecting the right VX or AX gasket?
faq_content.faq_answer: Absolutely! Our knowledgeable team is available to assist you in selecting the appropriate VX or AX gasket for your specific application. Please contact us if you need expert advice.

faq_content.faq_question: Can VX and AX gaskets be customized to fit specific dimensions?
faq_content.faq_answer: Yes, we provide customization options for VX and AX gaskets to ensure a perfect fit for your specific requirements. Contact us with your dimensional specifications for a personalized solution.

faq_content.faq_question: How long do VX and AX gaskets last?
faq_content.faq_answer: The lifespan of VX and AX gaskets depends on various factors, such as operating conditions, application, and maintenance. Generally, with proper installation and regular inspection, they can provide long-lasting sealing performance.
